pages.title: Arbor Heartwood Sample
pages.text: Wood from the World Tree, the structure outside every universe on whose branches universes grow. Its grain holds contradictory properties: warm and cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once. It smells faintly of rain on a world that has never existed.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Carving a piece from the Arbor Heartwood with my own hands, I expected the tree to resist. It did not. The sample came away clean, and it has not stopped changing temperature since.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Evolution Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.
